title: 第513章 吕祖不是兔子精第512章 上面有人
content_zh:
灵符到手，王道灵立即马不停蹄地回到了自己的老巢，那座以幻术维持的道观里。
随后，它将自己收拾干净，重新恢复成了神棍模样，揣着三张灵符便下了山，准备寻找机会，用灵符收了白蛇和青蛇。
......
翌日，恰逢四月十四，苏杭城南普济观的“吕祖”生辰。
这普济观的吕祖，可不是传说中的纯阳吕祖，而是苏杭城这一带的药材祖师。
也不知道这药材祖师为什么会这么勇，竟然也敢称吕祖！
他就不怕被纯阳真人找上门吗？
在药材祖师“吕祖”生辰的这一天，苏杭城的信徒都会去普济观烧香祈福，参加“挤神仙”的活动！
这“挤神仙”啊，传闻是这药材祖师爱热闹，喜欢亲近美女，因此在过生辰的这一天，会下凡化作普通人，跟这些烧香祈福的信徒挤在一起！
谁若是有缘，便会跟他挤到一起，得到赐福，随后保管是趋吉避凶，求财得财，求子得子......
根据这传闻来看，这药材“吕祖”并不靠谱；而等到了普济观，看到了观里供奉的神仙，就感觉更不靠谱了！
因为观里供奉的全是佛门神仙，一个正儿八经的道教神仙都没有！
借着吕祖的名号，拜着佛门的神仙，这不是挂羊头卖狗肉嘛！
......
许仙今天一大早便来到了普济观，独自一人上山，给观里的仙神上完香后，便在观里晃荡。
没过多久，许仙便在某个大殿门口，遇到了等他多时的蛤蟆怪王道灵！
再之后，在王道灵一番尾随外加神神叨叨的惊吓话语中，许仙最终用三十两银子买下了三张灵符，准备回保安堂烧掉，驱除保安堂里的鬼怪。
与此同时，林道然也来到了普济观山下。
他今天没穿道袍，身着一袭玄青色的长衫，腰间悬着青萍剑，手上拿着一把画着山水的纸扇，将自己扮成了书生模样。
他并不是来掺和许仙的事的，他只是纯粹好奇，想来看看究竟是哪位吃了熊心豹子胆的，竟敢打着吕祖的名号，来给佛门收拢香火！

上山的阶梯上，人来人往，熙熙攘攘。
信徒们或手持香烛，或提着供品，或抱着孩子，或搀着老人，一个个面带虔诚，朝着山上涌去。
林道然夹在人群中，一会随着人流登山，一会又跑了下来。
上上下下，上上下下......
就是不踏进普济观的山门。
时间一分一秒地过去，就在临近中午的时候，林道然正准备随着人流再次上山。
“嗡～”
一道凡人看不见的金色佛光，从山上快速飞来，然后落到山脚，缓缓散去。
一个身穿灰色长衫，面容略显猥琐的中年人，出现在林道然的视线中。
中年人的耳朵贼长，耳垂都垂到肩膀上了，像两片巨大的蒲扇，在微风中轻轻晃动。
两根门牙也很长，像龅牙苏一样，从嘴唇中探出，闪烁着淡黄色的光泽。
他的脸上虽然挂着一抹淡淡的笑容，但这笑容有点猥琐，有点淫邪......
中年人一出现，双眼立即在登山的人群中扫视了几遍，最终停在了一群待字闺中的年轻少女身上！
那群少女，约莫十六七岁模样，身着艳丽的衣裙，手持香烛，叽叽喳喳地说笑着，青春洋溢，活力四射。
中年人的眼睛，瞬间亮了！
“嘿嘿～”
他低声笑了起来，声音沙哑而淫邪，带着一种令人心悸的贪婪。
content_en:
After receiving the magic talisman, Wang Daoling immediately returned to his home nest, the Taoist temple maintained by illusion.
Afterwards, it cleaned itself up and returned to the appearance of a magic stick. It carried three magic talismans and went down the mountain, preparing to look for opportunities and use the magic talismans to collect the white snake and the green snake.
...
The next day happened to be April 14th, the birthday of "Lu Zu" at Puji Temple in the south of Suzhou and Hangzhou.
The Lu Zu of Puji Temple is not the legendary Chunyang Lu Zu, but the master of medicinal materials in this area of ​​Suzhou and Hangzhou.
I don’t know why this master of medicinal herbs is so brave and dares to call him Lu Zu!
Isn't he afraid that Master Chunyang will come to his door?
On the birthday of the founder of medicinal herbs, "Lu Zu", believers in Suzhou and Hangzhou will go to Puji Temple to burn incense and pray for blessings, and participate in the "crowding the gods" activity!
This "crowding god", it is said that the founder of medicinal herbs loves to be lively and gets close to beautiful women, so on his birthday, he will descend to earth and become an ordinary person, and crowd with these believers who burn incense and pray for blessings!
If anyone is destined, he will get together with him and receive blessings, and then keep it to seek good luck and avoid disaster, to seek wealth and gain wealth, to seek children and gain children...
According to this rumor, the medicinal material "Lv Zu" is not reliable; and when we arrived at Puji Temple and saw the gods enshrined in the temple, it felt even more unreliable!
Because all the gods enshrined in the temple are Buddhist deities, not even a serious Taoist deity!
Using the name of Lu Zu and worshiping Buddhist gods is not selling dog meat on the head of a sheep!
...
Xu Xian came to Puji Temple early this morning. He went up the mountain alone, offered incense to the immortals in the temple, and then wandered around the temple.
Not long after, Xu Xian met the toad monster Wang Daoling who had been waiting for him for a long time at the entrance of a certain hall!
Later, with Wang Daoling following him and saying scary words, Xu Xian finally bought three talismans with thirty taels of silver and planned to return to the security hall to burn them to drive away the ghosts in the security hall.
At the same time, Lin Daoran also came to the foot of Pujiguan Mountain.
He was not wearing a monk's robe today, but was wearing a dark blue gown, with a Qingping sword hanging on his waist. He was holding a paper fan with landscapes painted on it, pretending to be a scholar.
He didn't come to get involved in Xu Xian's affairs, he was just out of curiosity and wanted to see who was so brave that he dared to use Lu Zu's name to gather incense for Buddhism!
On the stairs going up the mountain, people were coming and going and it was bustling.
Believers were holding incense candles, offering offerings, holding children, or supporting the elderly. They all rushed towards the mountain with pious faces.
Lin Daoran was caught in the crowd, climbing up the mountain with the crowd for a while, and then ran down again.
Up and down, up and down...
Just don’t step into the gate of Puji Temple.
Time passed minute by minute, and just before noon, Lin Daoran was preparing to go up the mountain again with the flow of people.
"Buzz~"
A golden Buddha light invisible to mortals flew quickly from the mountain, then fell to the foot of the mountain and slowly dispersed.
A middle-aged man wearing a gray gown and a slightly wretched face appeared in Lin Daoran's sight.
The middle-aged man's ears are extremely long, and the earlobes hang down to his shoulders, like two huge cattail fans, swaying gently in the breeze.
The two front teeth are also very long, like buck teeth, protruding from the lips, shining with a light yellow luster.
Although there was a faint smile on his face, it was a bit obscene and a bit lewd...
As soon as the middle-aged man appeared, his eyes immediately scanned the crowd of climbers several times, and finally stopped at a group of young girls waiting to be married!
The group of girls, about sixteen or seventeen years old, were dressed in gorgeous dresses, holding incense candles, chattering and laughing, full of youth and vitality.
The middle-aged man's eyes suddenly lit up!
"Hehe~"
He laughed softly, his voice hoarse and lewd, with a heart-stopping sound.greedy.
